grammar.title: Indirect & Polite Question Formulations in Comprehensive Consultations
grammar.title_uz: To'liq Konsultatsiyada Bilvosita va Xushmuomala Savol Shakllari
grammar.title_ru: Косвенные и Вежливые Вопросы при Полной Консультации
grammar.title_en: Indirect & Polite Question Formulations in Comprehensive Consultations
grammar.rule_explanation: In comprehensive medical consultations, indirect questions ('Could you tell me if...', 'Would you mind sharing...') soften sensitive inquiries regarding medical conditions, dental anxiety, and medication history.
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Katta konsultatsiyada umumiy kasalliklar, allergiyalar va bemorning xavotirlari haqida so'rashda to'g'ridan-to'g'ri keskin savol o'rniga 'Could you tell me if...', 'Would you mind sharing...' kabi xushmuomala kirish iboralari qo'llaniladi.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Вежливые вводные фразы ('Could you tell me...', 'Would you mind...') помогают деликатно собрать подробный медицинский и аллергологический анамнез.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Indirect polite questions create trust and comfort when assessing medical history and dental anxiety.
grammar.structure_pattern: Could you please tell me + if / what / when + [Subject + Verb]? | Would you mind describing + [Symptom]?
grammar.structure_pattern_uz: Could you please tell me + if / what + [Ega + Fe'l]? | Would you mind describing + [Simptom]?
grammar.structure_pattern_ru: Could you please tell me + if / what + [Подлежащее + Глагол]? | Would you mind describing + [Симптом]?
grammar.structure_pattern_en: Could you please tell me + if / what / when + [Subject + Verb]? | Would you mind describing + [Symptom]?

examples.sentence: Could you please tell me if you have any history of hypertension or diabetes?
examples.translation_uz: Sizda qon bosimi ko'tarilishi yoki qandli diabet bo'lganmi, aytib bera olasizmi?
examples.translation_ru: Не могли бы вы сказать, есть ли у вас в анамнезе гипертония или сахарный диабет?
examples.note: Could you tell me if + Subject + Verb?

examples.sentence: Would you mind sharing what specific dental procedures make you feel most anxious?
examples.translation_uz: Aynan qaysi stomatologik muolajalar sizda ko'proq xavotir uyg'otishini aytib bera olasizmi?
examples.translation_ru: Не могли бы вы поделиться, какие именно стоматологические процедуры вызывают у вас наибольшее беспокойство?
examples.translation_en: Assessing dental anxiety with empathy and sensitivity.

common_mistakes.incorrect: Could you tell me what is your allergy?
common_mistakes.correct: Could you tell me what your allergy is?
common_mistakes.explanation_uz: Bilvosita savollarda so'z tartibi to'g'ri darak gap kabi bo'ladi (Ega + Fe'l).
common_mistakes.explanation_ru: В косвенных вопросах сохраняется прямой порядок слов: сначала подлежащее, затем глагол.
common_mistakes.explanation_en: Indirect questions require normal statement word order (Subject before Verb).

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: Good morning! Welcome to our clinic. What brings you in for a full consultation today?

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.text: Good morning, Doctor. It's been over a year since my last dental check-up. Recently, I've noticed some mild sensitivity to hot and cold food, and my gums bleed slightly when I brush. I wanted to get a comprehensive evaluation.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: You made the right decision coming in. A complete check-up is the best way to catch potential issues early. Before we begin the physical examination, do you have any pre-existing medical conditions, allergies, or are you currently taking any medications?

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.text: No major medical conditions or allergies, but I do take a daily multivitamin.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: Perfect. Let's start with a thorough clinical examination. I'm going to check your teeth, gums, tongue, and the soft tissues in your mouth. I'll also perform an oral cancer screening by gently palpating your jawline and neck area.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.text: Sounds good. Is that standard procedure for a full consultation?

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: Yes, absolutely. We evaluate not just the teeth, but the overall health of your entire mouth. Now, looking inside... I can see some soft plaque build-up and localized gingival inflammation around your lower incisors, which explains the bleeding. Also, there's a small area of discoloration on your upper right premolar that I want to investigate further.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: It could be an early-stage carious lesion. Based on my visual examination, we can manage this early on and also schedule a professional dental cleaning to resolve the gum inflammation. We will outline a tailored treatment plan for you right now.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.text: That sounds very clear and structured. Thank you, Doctor!

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: My pleasure! Let's discuss the next steps for your preventive care and get everything scheduled.

tests.question: What is the medical meaning of the term 'full consultation' in clinical consultation?
tests.explanation: 'full consultation' atamasining to'g'ri ma'nosi: to'liq konsultatsiya / ko'rik.

tests.question: Which term corresponds to 'surunkali / oldindan bor xastalik'?
tests.explanation: 'surunkali / oldindan bor xastalik' ma'nosiga mos keluvchi tibbiy termin 'pre-existing condition' hisoblanadi.

tests.question: Which of the following is the grammatically and clinically standard question to ask about the duration of symptoms?
tests.option_a: How long do you having this symptom?
tests.option_b: How long has this condition been bothering you?
tests.option_c: Since what time you have this problem?
tests.option_d: How many days you are feeling pain?
tests.explanation: Klinik anamnezda davomiylikni so'rash uchun Present Perfect Continuous ('How long has... been bothering you?') to'g'ri shakl hisoblanadi.

tests.question: When evaluating acute pain, what is the best phrasing to assess pain character?
tests.option_a: Is your pain bad or very bad?
tests.option_b: Can you describe the pain—is it sharp, dull, throbbing, or aching?
tests.option_c: Why do you have sharp pain today?
tests.explanation: Og'riq xarakterini aniqlashda shifokor ochiq va taklif qiluvchi variantlar (sharp, dull, throbbing, aching) beradi.
